notes: GRIMOIRE — A DESIGN SYSTEM FOR THE SURFACES YOU WORK IN. The Panel Editor stops wearing the theme of the panel it edits and wears its own. That was a deliberate decision a week ago and it had a good reason, but OG is an INSTRUMENT…

WHAT ACTUALLY CHANGED, IN TWO NUMBERS. Labels went 10px to 13px, and a spacing step now renders the pixels its name says — --fnd-space-24 was drawing 18. Every gap in the editor had been three-quarters of what it asked for, which is why…

Same palette family so the app still reads as one product: black ground, warm off-white ink, gold accent. Cleaner neutrals (OG greys are tinted toward its gold, which reads as depth at instrument size and as dirt at workspace size), three…
Editor only for now. Grimoire is held out of the theme chooser — it is the app’s own design system rather than a perk, so no entitlement is claimed for it.

Fixed while sweeping the new scale: a value readout was pinned to 38px and clipped its own number, the OLED badge clipped its title in the narrower column, and the panel name field had collapsed to 41px.
